**Orbital‑Invoices – Configuration Overview** | File | Purpose | Key Points | |------|---------|------------| | **`.env` / `.env.example`** | Holds all runtime secrets and feature flags. The example file is a template; the real `.env` is generated from the vault. | • `DATABASE_URL`, `REDIS_URL`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `JWT_SECRET`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `AWS_*` are mandatory.
• Feature toggle `FEATURE_DUNNING_V2` controls the new dunning logic.
• `APP_BASE_URL`, `PORT`, `LOG_LEVEL`, `INVOICE_PDF_TIMEOUT_MS` configure the API. | | **`src/config.js`** | Loads `dotenv`, validates required vars, and exposes a typed config object. | • Throws on missing required env vars.
• Parses numeric values (`PORT`, `DATABASE_POOL_MAX`, `TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS`).
• Exposes `config` for the rest of the app. | | **`docker-compose.yml`** | Orchestrates local dev containers. | • `db`: Postgres 16, user `oi_app`, SSL required.
• `cache`: Redis 7 with password.
• `api`: Builds the Node image, injects `.env`, depends on `db` & `cache`, exposes port 8080. | | **`Dockerfile`** | Builds the production image. | • Uses `node:20‑slim`.
• Installs only production deps (`npm ci --omit=dev`).
• Copies source and migrations, exposes 8080, runs `node src/server.js`. | | **`src/db.js`** | Sets up a Postgres connection pool and a simple health‑check. | • Uses `pg.Pool` with `connectionString` from config.
• `healthcheck()` runs `SELECT 1` to confirm connectivity. | | **`src/billing.js`** | Wraps Stripe logic for charging invoices. | • Loads Stripe with the secret key.
• `chargeInvoice(id)` fetches invoice data, creates a PaymentIntent, updates the DB, and returns status. | | **`src/server.js`** | HTTP API entry point. | • Express app with JSON body parsing.
• `/healthz` endpoint uses `healthcheck()`.
• `/invoices/:id/charge` triggers `chargeInvoice`. | | **`migrations/001_init.sql`** | Initial database schema. | • Creates `invoices` table with UUID PK, customer, amount, currency, status, Stripe intent, timestamps.
• Index on `customer_id` + `created_at`. | | **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** | GitHub Actions CI pipeline. | • Runs on push/PR.
• Installs Node 20, installs deps, runs tests (`npm test`). | **What the configuration does overall** 1. **Environment** – All secrets and feature flags live in `.env`. The app validates them on startup. 2. **Containerization** – `docker‑compose` spins up Postgres, Redis, and the API image for local dev; the Dockerfile builds the image for production. 3. **Database** – A Postgres pool is configured; migrations create the `invoices` table. 4. **Stripe integration** – `billing.js` charges invoices via Stripe
